raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Changes

Enable encoder SWA bounded replay with DP attention at attention TP=1. Pack prefix tails within the resolved per-rank prefill budget, synchronize replay rounds and let ranks without hits participate idly. Invalidate preplanned verification metadata after replay and keep temporary replay batches eager. Reuse the existing platform/model checks; require at least 128 prefill tokens per attention DP rank.

TRT-LLM and prefill CUDA graphs remain unsupported with bounded replay.

## Accuracy

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 2×GB300, TP2/DP2/EP2, MegaMoE + FlashMLA, native DSpark acceptance. GSM8K: 1,314 scored questions, five-shot chat, thinking disabled, temperature 0, concurrency 64, max output 4,096 tokens.

| Configuration | Correct | Accuracy | Request errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Replay disabled | 1,278 / 1,314 | 97.26% | 0 |
| Encoder replay enabled | 1,281 / 1,314 | 97.49% | 0 |

One encoder-replay completion reached the output limit; the baseline had none.

nodes.body:
Tested head `61853ed9c` on one GB300 node (2 x B300), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP2/DP2/EP2, MegaMoE + FlashMLA, native DSpark acceptance, prefill CUDA graphs disabled, `--swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.12`, `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.8`, `--chunked-prefill-size 16384` (8,192 per rank), `--max-running-requests 128`, behind sglang-router (`cache_aware`, `dp-aware`). Image `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-20261015-a6a8c560` with the PR's Python mounted over the install.

- The server starts with `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay` under DP attention (the previous guard rejected it).
- `test/registered/unit/model_executor/test_encoder_swa_replay.py`: 7 passed.
- GSM8K, 1,314 questions, five-shot chat, thinking off, temperature 0, 64 threads, max 4,096 output tokens. Two matched runs differing only in the flag:

| Configuration | Correct | Accuracy | HTTP 200 | Client errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Replay disabled | 1,282 / 1,314 | 97.56% | 1,314 / 1,314 | 0 |
| Encoder replay enabled | 1,284 / 1,314 | 97.72% | 1,314 / 1,314 | 0 |

- Replay-enabled run: 451 prefill batches carried replay rows (166,656 replay tokens total), no retractions, errors or stalls.
- Per-rank pools at the same budget: full KV 34,443,776 tokens/rank with replay on (target SWA as `request_window`) vs 14,034,688 with replay off (paged SWA).

One limitation of this check: cache-aware routing sent every request to a single DP rank, so each replay round exercised the idle-peer path on the other rank, but not both ranks replaying at once with different row counts. A round-robin rerun of both arms is queued; I will add it here when it finishes.

🚀 `ubuntu-latest` (4 tests): ✅ [View workflow run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38973383048) <!--rrt:0:done-->
```
cd test/ && python3 registered/unit/model_executor/test_encoder_swa_replay.py
cd test/ && python3 registered/unit/managers/scheduler_components/test_dp_attn.py
cd test/ && python3 registered/unit/model_executor/test_pool_configurator.py
cd test/ && python3 registered/unit/mem_cache/test_dsv4_compressed_pools.py
```

🚀 `4-gpu-gb300` (1 test): ✅ [View workflow run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38973397799) <!--rrt:1:done-->
```
cd test/ && python3 registered/e2e/models/test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300.py
```

Round-robin follow-up (same node type, image and settings as above, router `policy: round_robin` so both DP ranks take prefix hits in the same rounds):

| Configuration | Correct | Accuracy | HTTP 200 | Replay tokens DP0 / DP1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Replay disabled | 1,278 / 1,314 | 97.26% | 1,314 / 1,314 | 0 / 0 |
| Encoder replay enabled | 1,282 / 1,314 | 97.56% | 1,314 / 1,314 | 82,560 / 82,688 |

Both ranks carried replay rows in 496 and 489 of about 500 prefill batches each, with different row counts per round; no errors, retractions or stalls. Across the four runs today accuracy is 97.26 to 97.72% with no ordering by the flag.

One observation, not a regression: on this workload every request hits the shared five-shot prefix and replays up to 128 tails against about 225 new tokens, so the eval took 31% longer with replay on under round-robin (183 s vs 140 s) and 8% longer under cache-aware routing.
